verdict.rationale: Homebrew documents an unauthenticated JSON data API with curl examples and an example response schema. However, the evidence says outright that there is no runner and the examples are static. No OpenAPI or equivalent artifact exists either (probes returned 404), so there is no interactive reference with runnable examples, only a static, related-but-different reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
